RoomTask.title: RoomTask
RoomTask.description: Represents a hotel room housekeeping task, IoT status, and latest AI quality score scoped to an authenticated supervisor/staff user.

userId.description: Authenticated user UID owning this hotel workspace.

roomTitle.description: Arabic display title of the room.

status.description: Current operational status of the room.

subtitleNote.description: Short operational subtitle or guest check-out context.

iotSeverity.description: Severity of the IoT sensor status.

qualityScore.description: Latest AI inspection quality score (0 to 100).

alertActive.description: Whether an urgent supervisor AI fix alert is active for the housekeeper.

alertMessage.description: Actionable instructions sent to the housekeeper.

InspectionLog.title: InspectionLog
InspectionLog.description: Represents an AI visual & IoT inspection audit record for a hotel room.

userId.description: Authenticated user UID who performed the inspection.

surfaceIssues.description: Count of surface cleanliness issues detected.

summaryText.description: Concise Arabic summary of AI inspection findings.

notifiedHousekeeper.description: Whether the housekeeper was notified from this inspection.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the inspection occurred (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

ConsumableItem.title: ConsumableItem
ConsumableItem.description: Represents a hotel housekeeping consumable stock item (soap, shampoo, towels, amenities) with real-time threshold tracking and management low-stock alerts.

userId.description: Authenticated user UID owning this hotel inventory.

itemName.description: Arabic display name of the consumable item.

minThreshold.description: Minimum stock threshold; when currentStock <= minThreshold, low-stock alert triggers.

maxCapacity.description: Full storage capacity for progress calculation and restocking.

unitLabel.description: Unit of measure in Arabic (عبوة, قطعة, طقم).

storageLocation.description: Storage location or floor pantry name.

managementAlertSent.description: Whether a supply order / management low-stock alert has been dispatched.

alertNote.description: Management alert message or supply request status note.

/users/{userId}/room_tasks/{taskId}.description: Stores hotel room tasks, IoT statuses, and housekeeper alerts scoped per authenticated user.

/users/{userId}/inspections/{inspectionI.description: Stores AI visual and IoT inspection audit logs for analytics and history scoped per authenticated user.

/users/{userId}/consumables/{itemId}.description: Stores housekeeping consumable inventory items (soap, shampoo, towels, amenities) and management low-stock alerts scoped per authenticated user.
